crossRefs.note: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in…
then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that…
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies…

then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and…

translations.web: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;
translations.bsb: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause.
translations.kjv: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
translations.asv: then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling-place, and maintain their cause;
